name: Side Chat
description: A project-scoped sidebar chat that follows the current session and can return replies to the main input without sending.

en.name: Side Chat
en.description: A project-scoped sidebar chat that follows the current session and can return replies to the main input without sending.
en.safetyNotes: Host-owned models keep API keys private. Attachments are copied from user-selected File contents into bounded plugin-private caches and sent to separate Plan-mode sessions. agent.extension limits those sessions to read tools; reload and explicit approval are required. Main-session access remains optional context reading and draft-only return.

zh-CN.name: 侧边聊天
zh-CN.description: 按项目保存历史的侧边聊天：自动跟随当前会话，可将回复放回主输入框，不自动发送。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 通过宿主模型调用，不接触密钥。用户选择的附件内容保存在有上限的插件私有缓存，由独立 Plan 会话只读问答；agent.extension 限制该会话工具，需重载并明确授权。主会话仅可选读取上下文及主动回填草稿，不自动发送。

author: VastSa
changelog: Release 0.1.15: hide inactive automatically empty history buckets and distinguish same-name nonempty project histories without merging, deleting or changing their keys. Preserve attachments, permissions and main/side isolation.
safetyNotes: User-selected attachment bytes are stored in plugin-private per-conversation caches. Separate Plan sessions and an explicitly granted Agent extension restrict attachment Q&A to read tools. This is not an OS sandbox. No provider credentials, automatic main-session sending or main-composer attachment access.

settings.title: Attach session by default
settings.description: Include the automatically followed current session transcript in side-chat messages.
